title: GuardTalkOS web-install channel manifest
description: Metadata a future flashcore can fetch. Advertised set is tokay + akita + komodo + rango / dev/unlocked (DEC-WEBINSTALL-015, DEC-WEBINSTALL-007). Rango is experimental / boot HOLD, not production-boot-green. Not a GrapheneOS-equivalent locked verified-boot claim.

product.description: Advertised devices: Pixel 9 (tokay), Pixel 8a (akita), Pixel 9 Pro XL (komodo), Pixel 10 Pro Fold (rango, experimental / boot HOLD). Packer fails closed on unstamped shiba/husky/caiman/tegu/comet. Rango is image-ready, not production-boot-green.

advertisedDevices.description: Public allowlist. tokay, akita, komodo, and/or rango. Must include product. Rango is selectable experimental / boot HOLD.

reservedProducts.description: Must not list advertised devices (tokay, akita, komodo, rango). Unstamped products (shiba, husky, caiman, tegu, comet) may appear here; they must not appear in product/advertisedDevices.

channel.description: GOS-like channel token. MVP is dev, not stable.

verifiedBootClaim.description: Do not claim GrapheneOS-equivalent locked verified boot.

releaseId.description: First token of the channel pointer file.

unixEpoch.description: Second token of the channel pointer file (UTC seconds).

sourceStamp.description: Basename of the desktop-flash stamp this channel was packed from.

flashOrder.description: DEC-WEBINSTALL-006. Channel must not emit a zip that contradicts this order.

factoryZip.description: Null this wave. A full -install- zip is a documented follow-on.

phase.description: firmware first, then avb (avb_pkmd.bin), then os.
